purpose: Frozen-encoder linear-probe comparison on Potsdam and Vaihingen; aggregate metrics only.

protocol.head: single supervised linear layer on dense features
protocol.class_weighting: square-root inverse frequency from training labels only
protocol.input_normalization: per-dataset mean/std computed from source training scenes only
protocol.feature_grid_alignment: AnySat and TerraMind maps bilinearly upsampled to the common 60x60 scoring grid.

potsdam.source: Existing local Potsdam imagery and labels; fixed 18/6/14 scene split.

vaihingen.download_method: HTTP byte ranges from the official ISPRS-linked Seafile ZIP; only selected 2D members fetched

runtime.scope: Elapsed after model/data preload; includes four-fold OOF probes, final in-domain fits/evaluations, and both cross-domain evaluations. It is not per-tile inference latency.
